name: Rocco Forte Masseria Torre Maizza
positioning: Masseria Torre Maizza, a Puglian masseria near the Adriatic that blends local heritage with contemporary luxury, with its own beach club, Lido Bambù
best_for: Couples wanting suites with private gardens or countryside and sea views
Families or groups of friends taking over the Borgo degli Ulivi
Beach days at the hotel's beach club, pets included

facts.text: The hotel is in Savelletri di Fasano, Puglia, Italy.
The hotel blends local heritage with contemporary luxury.
Rooms have king-sized beds and stone bathrooms.
Suites pair interiors in natural shades with expansive private gardens.
The Borgo degli Ulivi has interconnected rooms for up to 22 guests, suited to family getaways or group retreats with friends.
The Irene Forte Spa fuses the regenerative powers of nature and science.
The hotel's beach club, Lido Bambù, is in Capitolo, south of Monopoli, with white sands on the Adriatic.
At Lido Bambù guests can have a sunset aperitivo with live music.
Summer experiences include a picnic beneath centuries-old olive trees.
Carosello restaurant is set in the masseria's former stables, with high whitewashed ceilings, rustic pews and garden views.

highlights.text: Forte Suites look over the Puglian countryside out to the Adriatic.
Junior suites combine the masseria's original features, including a vaulted ceiling, with contemporary design accents.
The Grand Suites of the Borgo degli Ulivi have private gardens and pools.
The Bougainvillea bar sits under the whitewashed arches of the masseria's 16th-century barn, reimagined by Olga Polizzi.
Summer experiences include a private yacht excursion along the Adriatic coast.

considerations.text: The beach club is not at the hotel: Lido Bambù is in Capitolo, south of Monopoli, and a hotel shuttle takes guests there.
The yacht excursion and the olive-grove picnic are offered as summer experiences.
WhataHotel notes the countryside location means you need transportation to reach nearby attractions.
